name: Karolina Nováková
source: Considered by many to be the prettiest girl in school, Karolina specializes in modelling. She’s gorgeous and fully aware of her charm. She is ruthless and will do anything to get what she wants. However, despite her overachieving ways and her promising future, Karolina finds herself struggling with her image and building relationships in general. Her best friend and “second in command” is Neha.
